newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit moves in range, under pressure from dlr.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit moves in range, under pressure from dlr.

text.p: The ringgit was rangebound, but under pressure from a surging dollar for a second consecutive day, dealers said on Tuesday.
They said volumes were extremely low and the market was hoping to bid up the ringgit whenever the dollar to took a breather from its rally against majors.
"If dollar/yen goes down even slightly, we can see the 2.5050 level tested," said a dealer with a Malaysian bank.
He said the direction could change once Europe opened.
"Expected weakening of the Singapore dollar should also help the ringgit," a dealer with a Malaysian bank said.
Many investors had been selling off the ringgit against the Singapore dollar in the last few weeks.
